overview: Ever wondered about the miracle workers who spend almost all their waking hours bringing life into this world? Take a glimpse into the lives of doctors working in the Obstetrics & Gynaecology department of a general hospital in First Touch. Against this frenzied backdrop emerges stories dealing with the common man's high hopes and deep-seated fears. And in this highly charged setting, one of our country's national obsessions is played out—the need for reproduction. This series is as much about the doctors as it is about the patients. We see many problems and issues through their eyes—their struggles as they make life and death decisions everyday and their exuberance and joy when they deliver a difficult birth.
title: First Touch

overview: The original version of the popular and long-running quiz show, hosted by Red Benson Contestants competed to see who had the more comprehensive knowledge of popular songs by trying to be the first to identify pieces of music. Additional challenges included contestants bidding to see who could "name that tune" in as few notes as possible.
title: Name That Tune

overview: "Hit" is a documentary project from Wink Originals about music. It will tell you why songs become hits and how music can influence entire eras. Vanya Dmitrienko, Shura, IOWA, FEDUK, Yulia Savicheva, Valeria, Fedor Bondarchuk and many others took part in the project. The audience will see how the clips were created, evaluate archival recordings from the filming, and hear the first versions of the hits. The creators of the series will tell about the history of pop music in the format of five-year plans, and at the end of the series they will record a small album with the biggest hits in the entire history of Russian pop: hits of the 90s and beyond are already waiting for you.
title: Хит

overview: The series follows the everyday life of the Valkeakoski Police Department.
title: Kummeli esittää: Kontio & Parmas

overview: Saturday crime series with Stephan Luca as chief inspector Adam and Lara Mandoki as his young, German-Hungarian assistant Karina.
title: Erzgebirgskrimi

overview: A popular TV game show where each participant could earn 1 million rubles using their intelligence and erudition.
title: О, счастливчик!

overview: An incredible journey into the planet's magnificent and magical oceans reveals new revelations about how the seas and their massive currents sustain not only the life within them but all life on Earth.
title: Into the Big Blue Heart

overview: When an explosion at a top-secret government lab injures an elderly janitor (Keith Szarabajka, Angel), no one could have expected the terrifying results. Exposure to mysterious chemicals causes him to undergo a bizarre transformation. He is slowly... incredibly... growing younger every day. Now, a ruthless CIA assassin will stop at nothing to take him prisoner and turn him into a government guinea pig. With his future on the line, the janitor goes on the run with his wife (Frances Sternhagen, Sex and the City) and a feisty female agent (Felicity Huffman, Desperate Housewives). All the while, he continues to transform... into a being with powers that are as deadly as they are unimaginable.
title: Stephen King's Golden Years

overview: He has fame, awards and Michelin stars — but amid an existential crisis, Dabiz Muñoz might close the restaurant that elevated him to world's best chef.
title: UniverXO Dabiz

overview: Six silver singles learn the new rules of modern dating while overcoming trust and self-esteem issues on their journey to find meaningful connections.
title: The Later Daters

overview: Hosted by Hayden Quinn, Taste of Australia takes viewers on a flavourful journey across the country, showcasing the diverse personalities, landscapes & ingredients that define Australia's food scene.
title: Taste of Australia with Hayden Quinn

overview: In 2020, Sheng Shi and Gu Lanshan's marriage, built on deceit and manipulation, began to crumble. Over time, they discovered new beginnings and the true meaning of love.
title: 101 Marriages

overview: Maxim Raisky is a talented investigator, capable of accurately revealing the motives of a criminal and recreating the picture of the crime from the most insignificant details. For his colleagues and loved ones, his instincts are a unique gift, but his contradictory character and methods of fighting criminals, on the contrary, are a complete headache.
title: Райский

overview: For 25-year-old Stéphanie, life takes a dramatic turn the day a compromising and humiliating video of her mother goes viral. Stéphanie is convinced that this video, which destroyed her mother's political career and destabilized her powerful family clan, is fake. This is despite the opinion of all the experts who certify its authenticity. But who would have fabricated this fake, and why? Despite having no prior experience in the field, Stéphanie, who has no talent for lying and is neither a spy nor a police officer, gets hired under a false identity at a startup she suspects has the technological capabilities to create incredibly sophisticated fakes. Drawn against her will into a dangerous conspiracy with international ramifications, Stéphanie will discover that the truth isn't where she expected to find it and that perfect lies come at a very high price.
title: L'Indétectable

overview: In 1979 Tokyo, four distinct sisters uncover their aging father's affair, causing their happy facades and bottled-up emotions to slowly unravel.
title: Asura

overview: This eight-episode series follows six families from different backgrounds, cultures and generations, all living on the same cul-de-sac, as they gather for the holiday season. During a time when emotions are amplified, each family comes together to celebrate their unique, rich traditions and navigate family eccentricities that ultimately help them discover what they do have in common: LOVE in all its different forms.
title: Holidazed

overview: Thorne, a television drama series which debuted on Sky1 in the UK on 10 October 2010, is based on crime writer Mark Billingham's novels. The series stars David Morrissey in the title role of Detective Inspector Tom Thorne, and includes Aidan Gillen, Eddie Marsan, and Natascha McElhone as supporting cast members.
title: Thorne

overview: After her family is massacred, General's daughter Xu Chuyun enters the capital to uncover the truth. Suspecting the wheelchair-bound Crown Prince Jiang Yunsheng, she marries into his household to investigate. As they work together, misunderstandings fade, and they join forces to solve mysteries and ultimately uncover the truth, united by their shared quest for justice.
title: Love and Strife

overview: To his nephew Er Pang, Uncle is the ultimate idol. A top student since childhood and a graduate of Harbin Institute of Technology. Uncle possesses a genius-like ability to master almost anything new without being taught. In the 1990s, as China's economy underwent a comprehensive transformation, Uncle, equipped with remarkable skills, was always brimming with new ambitions, which led him to start business after business. Though his "restless" journey was filled with hardships, it was through this constant striving that he came to appreciate the power of having family and friends by his side. In the end, it was his optimistic outlook on life that allowed him to realize his dreams.
title: Uncle

overview: Join David in the Milkshake! Studio where he will be playing some your favourite Milkshake! games that children can participate in at home.
title: Milkshake! Games

overview: Results, analysis and comment on the general election, along with live reports from around the country on the progress of the count.
title: Election 2024

overview: Join celebrated Irish chef Neven Maguire as he celebrates the magic of Christmas at the historic Cashel Palace Hotel in a two-part holiday special.
title: Neven's Christmas at Cashel

overview: Join host Patrick Kielty and a host of kids from all corners of the country for the biggest annual event on Irish television as they will reveal this year's most talked-about toys.
title: The Late Late Toy Show

overview: Since Nina's husband passed away, she and her children have received support from friends in the neighbourhood. However, she has met a new man, and has long been hesitant to tell her friends - but now is the time.
title: På gatan där jag bor

overview: In the new comedy series Bausjen we meet the six officers Eden, Kjetil, Are, Tina, Øystein and PK who make up a slightly dysfunctional, but charming, police unit in a town outside Oslo. With trust in the police at breaking point, any misstep can lead to disaster. No matter how hard they try to keep peace and order, chaos is never far away, neither at the station nor out in the field.
title: Bausjen

overview: In First to the End of the World, host Martin Johnsrud Sundby gives an epic challenge to four participating couples: they will embark on a 6,000-kilometer race from Marrakesh in Morocco to the End of the World in Norway, and they must get there without boarding a single plane. Without a mobile phone, and with a limited budget, the couples must navigate their way from Morocco via Spain, Portugal, France, Italy, Austria and Germany, before finally reaching the finish line in Norway.
title: Først til verdens ende

overview: Else Kåss Furuseth invites her absolute favourites from Norwegian entertainment to a fun performance in Christiania theatre, where anything can happen.
title: Best in Show

overview: Jon Almaas and his wife Ellen's dream of moving to a farm becomes reality, but life as a farmer becomes tougher than Jon had expected.
title: Jon blir bonde

overview: We follow doctors and nurses at the emergency room in Oslo. Oslo's new emergency room, which is Northern Europe's largest and most modern.
title: Legevakten

overview: Wild Battlegrounds tracks how different animals cope with their surroundings.
title: Wild Battlegrounds

overview: Daniel Wing investigates the unsolved murder of his own mother, Tina, determined to find out the truth about the tragedy that shaped his past.
title: Who Murdered You, Mum?

overview: A TV game in which each participant can earn 3 million rubles by answering 15 questions from various fields of knowledge.
title: Кто хочет стать миллионером?

overview: This hugely popular series will feature entertaining high-end performances and fascinating conversation against this very alluring backdrop. As a musical event, Scoil Samhraidh Willie Clancy showcases every single aspect of the tradition – the learners, the festival enthusiasts, the dancers, the singers, the discerning listeners, the younger modern players, and the professionals. Now celebrating 51 years, it continues to attract international crowds and huge talent into the tiny West Clare town of Miltown Malbay year-on-year. It has become something of a ‘Mecca of Music', and this series showcases the diversity of sights and sounds that can be found there annually. Each episode of this musically exciting series will take us from morning to night during a day at the summer school and features music, song, dance, and chat from a variety of characters from across the globe, and closer to home. Throughout the four episodes, we will meet a diverse and talented cohort of interesting characters.
title: Scoil Samhraidh Willie Clancy

overview: To save her father, young Ayuan is sold into a courtesan house and begins a life of constant change. She becomes a student in Japan, a governor's wife, a woman brave enough to leave an unhappy marriage, and a devoted mother who raises four daughters on her own. Refusing to surrender to fate, Dong Zhujun navigates the power struggles of old Shanghai and rises against the tide, eventually building the legendary Jinjiang Hotel empire.
title: The Way You Come Back

overview: Changing Rooms was a do-it-yourself home improvement show broadcast in the United Kingdom on the BBC between 1996 and 2004. The show was one of a number of home improvement and lifestyle shows popular in the late 1990s and early 2000s. The show was later franchised, generally under the same name, for the local TV markets in the United States, New Zealand and Australia.
title: Changing Rooms

overview: Yesenia, an unpopular introverted blogger, goes to a children's camp at the insistence of her mother. At the camp, she encounters absurd rules and a strict regime. Meeting the hyperactive Sanka and friendship with Karina and Vadik push Yesenia to fight the system. Together with her new friends, she decides to resist the despotic rules of their teacher and director. Now the fate of the entire camp depends on Yesenia and her friends.
title: Мы не дети

overview: What happens when two completely different women whose love lives are not going well come together and start looking for the "Main Boy"?
title: Esas Oğlan

overview: Musician and fervent campaigner for inclusion, access and equality, Elly-May Barnes leads the quest to create two bands made up entirely of musicians living with disability.
title: Headliners

overview: The story speaks of a love that transcends a millennium. The female protagonist, Qin Siyuan, is a shopkeeper who has lived for a thousand years, guarding a small store named Wuwang Pavilion. By day, she welcomes customers and lights up lanterns; by night, she lights lamps to guide the spirits of those on the brink of death. Each lamp she ignites fulfills someone's final wish. However, she cannot fulfill her death wish. Burdened by immense guilt, she is trapped outside the cycle of reincarnation, condemned to an immortal existence. When Shen Zheng accidentally stumbles into the Wuwang Pavilion, a peculiar phenomenon occurs with the Wuwang Lamp. Qin Siyuan realizes that her millennia-long wait has finally led her to the one destined to extinguish her lamp. At the same time, she discovers that Shen Zheng is fated to die before turning twenty and persuades him to stay in the shop to extend his life. "I'll extend your life, and you'll extinguish my lamp." At first glance, it seems like a great deal for Shen Zheng. However, Shen Zheng's rebellious nature clashes with Qin Siyuan's forceful and often violent attempts to control him. The two engage in relentless pursuit and resistance until Shen Zheng eventually yields, becoming her reluctant servant. Together, they embark on a journey to locate the elusive Lamp Extinguishing Cover hidden in the bustling city of Haidu. Amid perilous adventures, their bickering gradually turns into mutual affection.
title: Don't Forget Me

overview: The powerful imperial uncle Ye Beichen often loses sleep and goes crazy thinking about one person: Shangguan Weiyang, his niece-in-law. In his past life, Ye Beichen intended to secretly protect Shangguan Weiyang, but she resentfully shot herself and fell off the city wall donned in red, sinking him into an abyss of devastation. He was agonized and aggrieved, regretting his own fulfillment. So the obsessed Ye Beichen wants to reverse fate even at the expense of his life, just for a chance to see and love her again! In this life, Shangguan Weiyang is reborn, but she is forcibly taken and controlled by her former enemy Ye Beichen! Little did they know that Ye Beichen would be so possessed by his love that he would make his niece-in-law his wife! He is willing to be a murderous devil in Shangguan Weiyang's eyes as long as she is safe. The two of them are deeply entangled in love and hate, like fate unable to rest until death. Despite the most fatal misunderstanding, he keeps his deepest love a secret to himself. Unfortunately, two lifetimes of devoted love result in the most incomprehensible ending…
title: The Night is Still Young

overview: Having to replace his friend who embodies the Snowman at short notice, Simon sinks into a whirlwind of lies to hide this hobby from his family. He clumsily tries to conceal his new life from his girlfriend Caroline and his children Lily and Félix. His goal: to become the best Snowman of all time!
title: La Confrérie

overview: The historical-adventure movie series about the service of Soviet border guards.
title: Государственная граница

overview: Four women discover aerobics in Blagnac in the early 1980s: a sport little known in France at the time. But it's also a question of espionage, as Jane, the American aerobics teacher, is in fact a spy.
title: Toutouyoutou

overview: In the heart of Winnipeg's Anglophone basin in the 1960s, the Charbonneau family had to survive modestly by operating the El Toro snack bar following a financial setback.
title: El Toro

overview: Obeying only their own rules, Daphnée and Pierre, her parent, travel the vast world and concoct an epic daily life made up of small dangers and great joys; because nothing is more comforting than facing the vagaries of life alongside your faithful shield.
title: De Pierre en fille

overview: Marc and Sophie have launched a challenge, love, tenderness, cuddles and fantasy". They are happy, married, one a veterinarian, the other a doctor, and their shared waiting room is the scene of many adventures: mother-in-law, secretary, concierge, friends... everyone is there!
title: Marc et Sophie

overview: Between insurmountable complexes, thwarted love affairs, difficulty fitting in or false rumors, a group of twelve schoolchildren tell their stories every day. We go from laughter to tears we help each other and we always find a solution at François Truffaut College!
title: ASKIP, le collège se la raconte

overview: 6.30 pm is the time at which Eric and Melissa, two colleagues, leave the office each day to go to the same bus stop. Five minutes a day, wedged between work and family life, sketching out the year that will see these two looking for, finding or missing each other. More than just a matter of time, 18h30 is above all a setback.
title: 18h30

overview: The story of three women who are searching for true love despite being married.
title: Aşk, Evlilik, Boşanma

overview: The Richard & Judy show started with Channel 4 on 26 November 2001 and aired every weekday from 5pm to 6pm. Between 2006 and 2008, the Richard & Judy show shared this original timeslot with The Paul O'Grady Show, a programme that started in March 2006. For three months of each year, between 2006 and 2008, the Richard & Judy show occupied the 5pm to 6pm slot (January to March and June to August), and then the Paul O'Grady Show occupied the timeframe for the following three months (March to June and September to December). On the 15 August 2008 edition of the show, Richard stated that the following week's episode would be the last with Channel 4 and the final broadcast occurred on 22 August 2008.
title: Richard & Judy

overview: A tax inspector, Sara Santano, is tasked with proving that Celeste, a Latin music superstar, is a Spanish resident and must pay taxes. A high-stakes pursuit within the dreary world of the Tax Agency.
title: Celeste

overview: Esther and Fred Cavalieri form a flamboyant couple deeply united with their two children. So why does Esther, a woman seemingly without history and without enemies, find herself in mortal danger? To protect her, Fred hires Mathias, a bodyguard, while the police find the culprit.
title: Contre toi

overview: Géolocaliser l'amour is the series adaptation of the eponymous novel by poems by Simon Boulerice. Through a succession of sexual conquests, we accompany Simon in his nomenclature of disappointments, emotions and disarray that pave the way for his search for a soul mate (or a one-night stand) on dating apps. . Behind the telling of these stories, each more anecdotal than the other, hides a deep loneliness and a need to feel wanted. Simon can only rely on the loyalty of his best friend, Jocelyn, and Siri to get him to say "I love you" without panicking. Will he be able to find love in the age of smart phones?
title: Géolocaliser l'amour

overview: After 10 years of living together, two adored children and a dog, Romane and Philippe have separated. From this unique adventure, they made a film: "L'Amour flou". So here they are installed in this strange life, which in many ways turns out to be miraculous: the threat of separating no longer exists since it is done, the tensions between Philippe and Romane seem to have disappeared and they now speak the language. friendship. Children, on the other hand, seem to be bathed in happiness, with both parents close at hand. But the daily life of the Rebbot-Bohringer family is as crazy and vague as ever.
title: L'amour flou

overview: High school is the main setting of Clase 406, the realistic chronicle of a group of young people like many others, who live that bundle of years called adolescence with intensity and carelessness, joy and fear. They study, have fun and, among good friends and bad company, they will learn the difference between dreaming and working to make a dream come true; between demanding attention and earning respect; between promising and committing; between desiring and loving; between being a teenager and being an adult.
title: Clase 406

overview: Sheila, a 20-something intern in psychiatry, discovers a burlesque world and tries to help various patients, like Chantal Marignan, who takes herself for Beyoncé.
title: HP

overview: Aegon's Conquest is basically a direct prequel to the hit House of the Dragon, telling the story of the Targaryen's bloody and brutal conquest of Westeros. The story follows the invader Aegon Targaryen, who conquered the continent of Westeros with his sister wives, Rhaenys and Visenya, and their dragons. Aegon successfully unified six of the Seven Kingdoms in just two years, with only Dorne able to successfully resist. An official announcement regarding the same is awaited.
title: Aegon's Conquest

overview: Comedy-drama series about three twenty-something housemates trying to live normal lives, despite struggling with unusual afflictions - one is a werewolf, one is a vampire and the other is a ghost.
title: Being Human

overview: In the mid-1930s James Herriot, who has recently graduated from the veterinary college in Glasgow, finds work in the rustic Yorkshire Dales of Northern England. This heartwarming drama chronicles his encounters with the locals and the animals they depend on.
title: All Creatures Great and Small

overview: A semi-famous actress returns to her hometown to work with a regional theater troupe.
title: Kansas City Star
Vårt lille land - Under Guds øye

overview: "The path to wisdom requires strength and rigor" said Master Hoang. A 60-second heist as well...
title: The Way

overview: Set in the 1950's, a Japanese Antarctic research exploration team and 19 dogs that accompanied the team are stationed at the Showa Base in Antarctica. After a year, the exploration team is ordered to withdraw from the Antarctic station due to severe weather conditions. The dogs have to be left behind. The following year, the next team arrives at the Showa Base station and a miraculous reunion occurs between a dog handler accompanying the new tean and two dogs, Taro and Shiro, that are brothers.
title: Antarctica, the Story of a Man and a Dog Who Challenged the Realm of God

overview: Eustache, a sensitive and too friendly young bachelor wants to become a "badass", a real one! If Hercules has done the 12 labors, Eustache faces the turpitudes of everyday life, to reveal his dark side at all costs. But things rarely go as planned...
title: Dawaland

overview: The series brings to the fore an original love story, between two mature people, caught between two completely different worlds, but who have the chance to rebuild their lives, next to each other and find happiness beyond all the hardships they have had and continues to take part. Ştefan (Adi Nartea), a former footballer in a top team from Great Britain, used to the rhythm of the luxurious life in the city, but divorced and the father of a teenage child, arrives in the idyllic village where Anda (Michaela Prosan), a single mother, respected doctor in the community where life has a different rhythm. The two end up experiencing a totally unexpected love. Dark secrets, jealousies, intrigues and lies of all kinds will stand in their way every step of the way until they find their way to each other, in a place where people live and love by different rules.
title: Iubire cu parfum de lavandă

overview: Francisco Quintana returns to Jimmy Carter School as a teacher. There he encounters young people who follow the rules they themselves create.
title: Francisco el Matemático: Clase 2017

overview: Roc chronicles the ups and downs of Baltimore garbage collector Charles "Roc" Emerson, a tightwad who constantly brought home "perks" (i.e. items thrown away by residents on his route); his wife Eleanor, a registered nurse; his womanizing younger brother Joey, a ne'er-do-well musician who had recently returned to the neighborhood; and his father Andrew, a retired Pullman porter.
title: Roc

overview: Victoria, an important and well-known Mexican businesswoman, and José Ángel, a simple and honest man who has dedicated his life to the countryside, by chance meet Victoria, saving her life and over time a love relationship will arise.
title: Amores Verdaderos

overview: A maths teacher is hired by Jimmy Carter Elementary School, where he must deal with the rebellious attitudes of some students.
title: Francisco, el matemático

overview: This immersive series follows archaeological teams across the Middle East as they embark on a new season of excavations, uncovering the cities and civilizations featured in the Bible. From the lost city of Exodus in Egypt to the epic Tower of Babel in Iraq, their discoveries shed new light on the Bible's most famous stories. Stunning CGI and embedded cameras reveal treasures buried for millennia.
title: Lost Treasures of the Bible

overview: TMZ dives deep inside the latest Diddy headlines.
title: TMZ Presents: The Downfall of Diddy

overview: Baretta is an undercover cop in the Serpico mode. Like your standard TV-issue rule-bending loner cop, he butts heads with his excitable superior (veteran character actor Dana Elcar of MacGuyver and Baa Baa Black Sheep fame). He lives in the run-down King Edwards Motel with his scene-stealing pet cockatoo. With its ersatz funky score, Baretta is time-capsule '70s television. And, as Baretta was fond of saying, you can take that to the bank.
title: Baretta

overview: My Generation takes an in-depth look at four distinct generations and how members of each have been shaped by the cultural and political events of their time.
title: My Generation

overview: Winter 1915, a French trench was shelled, all the soldiers were buried leaving only one survivor. Underground, he manages to extract himself and crawl into a hole leading to a tunnel. Then begins a journey which will embark our soldier in the mysterious village of Gliwensbourg, in 1925 ...
title: Les Chroniques de Gliwensbourg

overview: Colombian comedy miniseries about Zoroastro, a mineralist who arrives at the hacienda la vía láctea to find his reincarnated mother, there he meets Susana, the daughter of the hacienda's owner and who is about to get engaged in marriage with the nephew of the woman who lives with his father.
title: Leche

overview: Three recently orphan teenagers struggle to survive life by themselves. With the help of friends and neighbors from their small apartment's community, they learn to survive life and accept their new reality .
title: Sabor a limón

overview: Jake Humphrey hosts the general knowledge quiz where contestants can win up to £12,000 if they can give a correct answer to a question before all their opponents in The Pack do. Contestants in control must play a strategic game to take home as much money as they can.
title: Beat the Pack
